admin.consent.enabled: Consent banner when Google is configured
admin.consent.flow_hint: Flow: consent defaults (denied) → banner → on accept gtag('consent','update',…). Preference stored in nexis_consent (JSON).
admin.consent.google_hint: Without at least one valid ID, no banner is shown and no consent is requested. With GTM, GA4/Ads may live in the container.
admin.consent.intro: Consent banner for Google Consent Mode v2 (GA4, GTM, Ads). Shown only when a Google ID is configured.
admin.consent.legal_hint: Legally: strictly necessary cookies (session, CSRF, security) do not require consent—only disclosure in your privacy policy. Analytics/marketing (Google) requires prior opt-in consent (ePrivacy/GDPR).
admin.consent.no_tracking_hint: No Google IDs configured: no cookie banner is shown and nothing needs to be accepted. Describe strictly necessary cookies in your privacy policy.
admin.consent.privacy_hint: Link in the banner; default after install: /de/datenschutz (footer menu).
admin.consent.title: Consent & Google
admin.error.consent_google_ids: Check Google IDs: GA4 starts with G-, GTM with GTM-, Ads with AW-.
admin.error.consent_save_failed: Consent settings could not be saved.
admin.plugins.desc.consent: Consent banner with Google Consent Mode (GA4/GTM/Ads).
public.consent.text: We use Google services for analytics and/or marketing. This requires your consent (opt-in). Strictly necessary cookies are set without consent.
